Business context, made concrete

The same question should use the same definition.

If a dashboard and an AI assistant interpret “revenue” differently, the answers will disagree. Shared definitions keep both grounded in your business rules.

Example definition

Recognized revenue = posted invoice amounts, less credits; excludes sales tax and unaccepted estimates.

Reporting + AI

“What changed in revenue this month?” uses that same definition, reporting period, and approved data in both places.

Broader consulting engagement

Full AI Readiness Assessment

Build a roadmap across your operational and financial systems.

  • System inventory and data-flow mapping
  • Definitions for 10–20 important business metrics
  • Data-quality, permissions, and business-context review
  • Prioritized analytics, agent, and automation opportunities
  • Implementation roadmap with dependencies and effort estimates

Quoted after a scoping call. Implementation and ongoing support are agreed separately.

Free trials are approved individually after a short conversation and begin once scope and sample data are agreed. No credit card and no automatic paid plan. The assessment is a readiness review; integrations, extensive cleanup, production agents, and security certification are outside the free scope.

AI Document & Invoice Intelligence

From incoming invoices to review-ready data.

When invoice details live in PDFs, email attachments, and spreadsheets, your team spends time entering data and checking it by hand. Hicks Analytics helps you build a repeatable workflow for extraction, validation, and review.

  • Capture vendor, invoice number, dates, amounts, and line items.
  • Flag missing information, inconsistent totals, potential duplicates, and amounts that need review.
  • Give reviewers a clear exception queue, approval controls, and an audit history.
  • Connect approved records to reporting and downstream workflows as part of a scoped implementation.

The engagement starts with your documents, your business rules, and your approval process. Together, we define the checks, access needs, and integrations before implementation.

Assess My Document Workflow Book a Discovery Call

Human approval stays part of the workflow. Extraction results need validation before they are used for financial decisions.
